title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In — August 06, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's your boy Ambitriber here with this week's portfolio update. I've been getting a lot of questions about my holdings lately, so I thought I'd take some time to walk you through my top positions and why I'm holding them.

First off, let's talk about my exposure to the US market through the iShares Edge MSCI USA Value Factor UCITS ETF (QDVI.DE). I've been a fan of value investing for a while now, and I believe this ETF is a great way to tap into that strategy. With its focus on undervalued companies, I think it's a solid way to weather any potential market downturns. Plus, its 10.12% allocation to my portfolio means I'm getting a nice chunk of exposure to the US market without overdoing it.

Another holding I want to mention is the VanEck Gold Miners UCITS ETF (G2X.DE). I know some people might be thinking, "Gold? Really?" But I believe it's a great way to add some diversification to my portfolio and protect against inflation. With gold prices looking strong lately, I'm feeling pretty good about this 1.97% allocation.

As for any strategic moves, I'm actually considering rebalancing my portfolio to make some room for some new positions. But for now, I'm staying the course and sticking with my existing holdings. I believe in the long-term potential of each of these investments, and I'm not looking to make any drastic changes just yet.

Looking forward, I'm excited to see how the rest of the year plays out. With interest rates starting to come down and the economy looking like it's on the mend, I think there are some great opportunities on the horizon. So, if you're feeling nervous or unsure about the market, just remember: stay disciplined, stay patient, and always keep a long-term perspective. Thanks for following along, everyone!
